long_biography.plain_text:
Vince Leonardo created Rochester Exhibit Services after three decades managing Bausch & Lomb's in-house trade-show department. His son James later assumed leadership of the family company, bringing an operator's focus to custom exhibit design, fabrication and complex event programmes. Under James, RES developed into a nationally active experiential-marketing firm serving clients across numerous industries.

Leonardo combined ownership with day-to-day executive leadership for many years. The business integrated creative strategy, engineering, fabrication, logistics and on-site execution from facilities in Rochester and near Las Vegas. In 2025, he transferred operating control to a new president and moved to the board, where he continued providing strategic counsel. That transition left his durable role as the second-generation owner-operator who expanded and professionalised the business his father established.

Current RES history identifies Vince Leonardo as the original founder, and his obituary identifies James V. Leonardo as his son. Some 2025 transition material calls James the founder and chief executive, but the dossier treats that wording as loose corporate shorthand and classifies James as the second-generation owner-operator rather than the original founder.

Inherited and expanded is supported by the father-founded family business, the exact father-son link, James's long managing-member tenure and later documented ownership. Public sources do not disclose the precise transfer date, consideration, estate route or current ownership percentage, so the dossier does not claim a specific inheritance event.

Industry reporting states that Leonardo transferred day-to-day operating control to a new president in October 2025 and moved to the board while retaining a strategic advisory role. The current RES leadership page names operating executives but does not publish a board roster, so the board classification relies on the explicit transition announcement.

Service is used for both wealth fields because RES sells integrated creative, engineering, fabrication, logistics and programme-management services. Advertising is the minimum useful active tag because the company's defining purpose is experiential marketing and branded audience engagement; inactive Trade exhibitions and Event organisation tags are excluded.

The existing LinkedIn profile is retained because its exact URL comes from the authoritative record and its RES and Rochester markers are independently corroborated. No defensible personal Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube, TikTok, personal website, Wikipedia page or dedicated Forbes profile was found, and the general RES company site is not proposed as a personal social profile.

No reliable public source reviewed establishes Leonardo's birth date, birthplace, education, secondary nationality or early career before RES. Those fields remain unfilled rather than being inferred from family records or namesakes.

All vessel names, ownership periods, specifications, values, movements and holding structures are excluded from both biographies and all wealth classifications. Procedural litigation, private addresses, loan balances, directory revenue estimates and personal net-worth estimates are also omitted.
